answer: Bind each identity to a physical chip. Every epoch an agent submits an AMD SEV-SNP attestation report, signed through AMD's certificate chain; the network hashes its CHIP_ID and allows one live key per hash. A farm can't grow a garden of 500 heads in VMs on one server, since every VM reports the same chip; it needs 500 real CPUs. Rotating keys is no haven, because the new key lands on the same hash. An honest agent on a laptop out on a desert mesa needs only the chip it already has.
